install.notes: policy/pyproject.toml:10 requires Python 3.12 or newer and :22-23 lists mujoco and gymnasium; the policy directory is flat scripts, not an installable package (policy/pyproject.toml:28-30), so there is no install command. The gate and the fake backend need neither package: fake.py is pure Python. Install the upstream dependencies only to run the upstream MuJoCo environment, which was not run.
